en:
{RIVAL}: Yo! {PLAYER}!\pYou're still struggling along back
here?\pI'm doing great! I caught a bunch
of strong and smart POKéMON!\pHere, let me see what you caught,
{PLAYER}!
Hey!\nTake it easy!\lYou won already!

{RIVAL}: Hey, guess what?\pI went to BILL's and got him to
show me his rare POKéMON.\pThat added a lot of pages to my
POKéDEX!\pAfter all, BILL's world famous as a
POKéMANIAC.\pHe invented the POKéMON Storage
System on PC, too.\pSince you're using his system,
you should go thank him.\pWell, I better get rolling!
Smell ya later!
Oh, yeah, right.\pI feel sorry for you. No, really.\nYou're always plodding behind me.\pSo here, I'll give you a little\npresent as a favor.

A chatty gossip like you…
That thing's perfect.\pI don't need it because I don't
give a hoot about others.\pAll right, this time I really am
gone. Smell ya!

Hey! Stay out!
It's not your yard!\p…Huh?
Me?\pI'm an innocent bystander!
Don't you believe me?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_ROCKET}
GRUNT: Stop! I give up!\nI'll leave quietly!
…Okay.\nI'll return the TM I stole.
{PLAYER} recovered TM28 from\nthe TEAM ROCKET GRUNT.
I better get moving!\nBye!
Make room for this!\nI can't run until I give it to you!
You're a TRAINER, too?\pCollecting, battling…\nIt's a tough life, isn't it?

Did you know that you can CUT down
small trees?\pEven that small tree in front of
the shop can be CUT down.\pI think there's a way around it,
though.

If that SLOWBRO wasn't there, you
could CUT down the small tree.\pThat way, you could get to the
other side.\pI think there's a way around it,
though.
You're making an encyclopedia on\nPOKéMON? That sounds amusing.
The people here were robbed.\pIt's obvious that TEAM ROCKET is\nbehind this most heinous crime!\pEven our POLICE FORCE has\ntrouble with the ROCKETS!
Okay! SLOWBRO!\nUse SONICBOOM!
Come on, SLOWBRO, pay attention!
SLOWBRO, punch!
No!\nYou blew it again!
SLOWBRO, WITHDRAW!
No! That's wrong!\nIt's so hard to control POKéMON!\pYour POKéMON's obedience depends\non your abilities as a TRAINER.
SLOWBRO took a snooze…
SLOWBRO is loafing around…
SLOWBRO turned away…
SLOWBRO ignored orders…
I want a bright red bicycle.\pI'll keep it at home, so it won't\nget dirty.

This is CERULEAN CAVE.\pHorribly strong POKéMON live inside
there.\pIt takes a very special TRAINER to
be allowed inside there.\pYou'd have to be strong enough to
become the POKéMON LEAGUE\lCHAMPION for starters.\pAnd, you would have to have
made a great achievement.
CERULEAN CITY\nA Mysterious, Blue Aura Surrounds\lIt
TRAINER TIPS\pA POKéMON can be made to hold\nan item.\pSome items can even be used by\nthe holding POKéMON in battle.
Grass and caves handled easily!\nBIKE SHOP
CERULEAN CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MISTY\lThe Tomboyish Mermaid!
